verdict.rationale: OpenCode supports adding external tools/agents via MCP (local and remote servers) and exposes an SDK plus a headless server/OpenAPI endpoint for building custom integrations, which lets a lead wire third-party tooling into workflows. However there's no evidence of a curated partner marketplace or named partner-built 'agent apps' (only LLM provider logins like Copilot/ChatGPT are shown), so this is generic extensibility rather than a demonstrated partner ecosystem. Missing for 10: documented partner/marketplace integrations, case studies of third-party agent apps plugged in, and independent confirmation these integrations work reliably in production.
